title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Etess Arena, Atlantic City | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Etess Arena at the Trump Taj Mahal casino in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on 15 July 2006.

It was the 21st show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the Etess Arena on 12, 13, and 14 February 1999, 12 May 2000, 10 August 2001, and 2 August 2003. He returned there on 28 June 2008 and 24 September 2022.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
